en.hardwareChoice.connectionReady: Blocks and connection ready; download pending
en.hardwareChoice.downloadReady: Blocks, connection and download ready; run control pending
en.hardwareChoice.programReady: Blocks, USB download and run implemented; hardware validation pending
en.hardwareChoice.stopConfirm: Switching hardware will stop the program on the current device. Continue?
en.hardwareChoice.codePending: Code generation for this hardware is not available yet.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_BUSY: A download, update or hardware switch is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_UNKNOWN: This project uses unsupported hardware. Your current program has been preserved.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_PROJECT_VERSION: This project uses a newer hardware format. Update the software to open it.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_NOT_READY: Blocks and communication for this hardware are not available yet.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_EXTENSION: This project contains extensions incompatible with its hardware. Your current program has been preserved.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_DRAFT_INVALID: The hardware draft could not be read. Your current program has been preserved.
en.hardwareChoice.failed: Hardware could not be switched. Your original program has been preserved. Try again.
en.hardwareChoice.restoreFailed: Automatic recovery did not finish. Your original program remains in the local hardware draft.
en.hardwareChoice.discardSwitchDetail: The current unsaved program and all device drafts will be discarded. The selected device will open a blank project. Save anything you want to keep first. Saved project files will not be deleted.
en.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_DRAFT_CLEAR: Device drafts could not be cleared. The switch was cancelled.

ru.hardwareChoice.connectionReady: Блоки и связь готовы; загрузка ещё не подключена
ru.hardwareChoice.downloadReady: Блоки, связь и загрузка готовы; управление запуском ещё не подключено
ru.hardwareChoice.programReady: Блоки, USB-загрузка и запуск реализованы; проверка на устройстве ожидается

ru.hardwareChoice.codePending: Генерация кода для этого устройства пока недоступна.
ru.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_BUSY: Идёт загрузка, обновление или смена устройства. Повторите попытку после завершения.
ru.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_UNKNOWN: Проект использует неподдерживаемое устройство. Текущая программа сохранена.
ru.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_PROJECT_VERSION: Проект использует более новый формат устройства. Обновите приложение.
ru.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_NOT_READY: Блоки и связь для этого устройства пока недоступны.

ru.hardwareChoice.HARDWARE_DRAFT_CLEAR: Не удалось удалить черновики. Переключение отменено.
